primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.
No actual construct/delivery functional dose, expression interval or executable preparation/calibration-to-choice workflow for the core targeting implementation.
No quantitative physiological acceptance or reference accuracy rule derives that level; automated tracking is not validated against an independent scored reference.
Omissions and all eligible trials are retained, but corrupted or missing tracking/event measurements and ambiguous choice calls have no explicit numerical handling rule.
The multiple planned timing and secondary confirmatory contrasts have no specified multiplicity correction or gatekeeping procedure.
No bounded light/duration exploration or rule deriving its bounds and calibration stop.
Repairs are proposed, but revised conditions are not explicitly refrozen and tested on a fresh independent confirmatory dataset.
No linked raw videos/events, animal/trial IDs and exact acquisition/processing/code/environment/model versions sufficient to reconstruct results.

Good terminal targeting, collateral/kinetics verification and prospectively defined positive, negative and procedural controls. Independent animal power, randomized concealed groups, blinded analysis and all-trial/omission decomposition are sound. Task-matched movement and sensory variants, explicit equivalence bounds and avoidance of primary post-treatment adjustment support limited performance-necessity conclusions. Technical/welfare stopping and diagnostic repair are appropriate.
